add-portless-proxy-env.description: The portless proxy starts unprivileged on HTTPS: targetDefaults.portless gets PORTLESS_UNPRIVILEGED=1 and PORTLESS_HTTPS=1 (#4768).

add-local-postgres.description: A db package gets the local Postgres of a root compose.dev.yml, its up and down targets, the local CONNECTION_STRING, and ^up in its backend's serve (ADR 0012 decisions 16 and 17).

node-env-production.description: NODE_ENV is production in every setup and code never reads it: the configuration of ADR 0016, and a log of each NODE_ENV read in source.

add-prisma-client-inputs.description: A repo with @zukhruf/nx/prisma hashes the generated Prisma client: targetDefaults.typecheck and .build get the inputs "..." and { "dependentTasksOutputFiles": "**/*.ts" } (#4826, ADR 0012 decision 6).

add-migrate-check.description: The typecheck of a db package runs migrate:check, which fails when the migrations do not build the schema: targetDefaults.typecheck.dependsOn gets "migrate:check" in a repo with @zukhruf/nx/prisma (#4937, ADR 0018).

add-generated-source-defaults.description: A task that reads generated code runs its generator first and hashes its output: in a repo whose nx.json init wrote, typecheck, build, test, lint and dev (and the @nx/esbuild:esbuild default) get dependsOn "generate" and "^sdk", lint also "^build", and typecheck, build and lint the input { "dependentTasksOutputFiles": "**/*.ts" }; a web test target loses the dependsOn ["^sdk"] that hid the rule, and each other target that hides it is logged (#5219, ADR 0019).
